name: self-compact
description: Claude Code plugin that lets Claude compact its own context at task milestones: agent-initiated /compact with self-written handoff instructions, gated by context size, then auto-continue. Smarter auto-compact for long sessions. English and Chinese UI.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of everything the plugin shows or tells Claude: "en" (default) or "zh". Any other value falls back to English.

floorPct.title: Compaction floor (%)
floorPct.description: compact_now is denied while the context is below this percentage of the window

maxPostRatio.title: Max post/pre size ratio
maxPostRatio.description: Upper bound on the estimated post-compaction size as a share of the current size; above it the call is denied

nudgeStartPct.title: Start nudging (%)
nudgeStartPct.description: Context percentage at which Claude starts being reminded to look for a node

nudgeStepPct.title: Nudge step (%)
nudgeStepPct.description: Remind again after each further rise of this many percentage points

urgentPct.title: Urgent nudge (%)
urgentPct.description: From this percentage the reminder escalates to compacting at the next safe step

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: When off, every compact_now call is denied and no nudges are sent

releaseStopHooks.title: Release Stop hooks
releaseStopHooks.description: Let a queued compaction end a turn that another Stop hook (such as /goal) holds open. Has no effect where Claude Code's built-in guard (cc-plugin-sec-default) loads — Team/Enterprise logins and machines with managed settings — because user mods' Stop hooks don't run there.

autoNodes.title: Autonomous node triggers
autoNodes.description: Flag node-like tool calls (push, PR, spec/plan written, todos done), run a turn-end self-check and hint on topic switches so Claude compacts without being asked. Off disables all three

turnEndCheck.title: Turn-end self-check
turnEndCheck.description: After a node or a long uncompacted stretch, submit one short prompt asking Claude whether to compact. Needs Autonomous node triggers
